description: CreateDatabase(path, dbLangGeneral, dbVersion120); CREATE TABLE L (k LONG CONSTRAINT PK_L PRIMARY KEY); Close; DBEngine.SetOption(dbImplicitCommitSync, "Yes"); OpenDatabase shared read/write. L(k LONG primary key) with keys 1..1204 inserted ascending (the second leaf full, as in append-full-rightmost-covered), then key 100000 (7f 80 01 86 a0, not covered by the leaf's prefix 7f 80 00), then 100001. Headers of pages 44-63 after keys 1190-1204 and after each later insert; pages 44-59 whole after keys 1203, 1204, 100000 and 100001. Asks the same for a key the full leaf's prefix does not cover (r-q7 long-split-insert-wider asked it of a leaf that was not full).
